family112.use: Scoped repair for queued family-112 restrictions; no use in the current random-core proof.
family112.scope: Categorical width<=w clauses, independent Bernoulli-p live coordinates and uniform q-ary fixed values: expected number of distinct minimal wide surviving types <=Theta=sum_(ell=b+1)^w binom(w,ell)(q*p/(1-p))^ell, b>=0, with no Theta<1 requirement. Full cube gives literal narrow subclauses and divisibility. Affine support gives only compatible-cylinder/fibre equivalence.
family112.ledger: Complete fresh ENS blocks and actual selected input positions f_j=g_sj; literal g_i=sum a_ij*f_j, deg a_ij+deg f_j<=deg g_i. Zeroing nonselected coefficients gives degree-nonincreasing PC/NS replay with original product/companion/fresh-field costs.
family112.missing: Hard-surviving restriction law and coverage of arbitrary nonlinear source inputs.

slice.use: Old-design representation and scope control for eventual transfer, not a new old family.
slice.scope: For n=2^m-1,k=2^r,1<=r<m, characteristic-two k-subset summation agrees with zero evaluation below degree k. Ternary affine-flow lift on connected simple graph, maximum degree Delta, expansion epsilon, nonzero total charge, max(4,2Delta)<=D<epsilon*n/8 and2D/epsilon<k; global moments through2D give nondegenerate binary pairing on the existing Q_D without J_(2D).
slice.limitations: n counts graph vertices, not total Boolean variables. Pin t edges: proper residual degree D-t requires the stated odd parity test and D-t>=max(2,Delta). Conditional fibres can have even mass; odd cotree-pinned fibres can be easy trees. Real signed mass does not bound finite-field rank.

rank_split.use: Candidate linear-algebra tool for fixed-cutoff maps, only after a common nondegenerate quotient/form is independently supplied.
rank_split.scope: Finite-dimensional W and U_i with nondegenerate symmetric bilinear or Hermitian forms for one fixed involution; A_i:U_i->W,L>=1. Let r_i=rank A_i,kappa_i=r_i-rank(A_i* A_i),d_i=rank vertical_stack_(j!=i)(A_j* A_i). Orthogonal self-adjoint projections P_s sum I and total off-label rank <=(L-1)sum_i min(r_i,2d_i+kappa_i), hence <=(L-1)(2sum_(i!=j)rank(A_j* A_i)+sum_i kappa_i). Zero projections allowed.
rank_split.limitations: Constructs no proper invariant or surviving unit. Actual cross-Gram/radical bounds still needed. Odd-denominator rational channels can have arbitrarily small real variance yet reduce to deterministic characteristic-two channels.

integration: Scope import only; no whole-branch merge, publication, new hardness claim or imported-proof dependency in current theorem.
